reviews.t: Finally a solution for my decades-long skin issues. And thx for fixing the leaky bottle prob!
reviews.x: This is the only moisturizer that keeps the dry patches on my face from getting itchy and enflamed. It’s oily rather than a cream. But I don’t care, because it works and I finally have relief after 25 years. Will keep buying, especially now that they fixed the leaky bottle problem.

reviews.t: This is really a great moisturizer, sinks right in
reviews.x: This is really a great moisturizer, sinks right in, no greasy feeling and I will keep using it when I do need a moisturizer. So far everything that I have tried from Mother Dirt is just great. Thank You !!

I am so happy I found this moisturizer. I always had great non-problematic skin, but at some point due to making my skin go through too much (think enzyme peels, especially by Biologique Recherche) my skin became reactive. I found this moisturizer when everything else would to some extent irritate my skin. These products have changed my skin in a matter of days. I am so impressed. In my sixties now .. I have gone thru so many jars of promises but disappointment was the typical outcome. So I can give an honest opinion and that is try it ...you will be glad you did.

Totally love the product. Moisturizers perfectly without leaving my skin greasy. Only 4 stars though because the nozzle leaks and a lot is getting wasted. Which is a bummer because it's pricey. Mine might just be a defective container-- the top won't screw on correctly. Was crooked when it came so it seems to be lacking a tight seal. If you're on the fence I'd still go for it, because your skin will love it. Gentle, effective, and totally odor-free.

This did not cut it. it was basically just adding an oil slick to my face , I could feel my powder make up sliding off through the day. yuck.

had high hopes for this product, makes me break out, doesn't soak up into the skin even when used in a very small amount, won't buy again.

But after using this in combination with the face wash and AO+ mist, my skin feels amazing and hydrated all day long.

reviews.t: I've truly loved all the products I've tried from this line
reviews.x: I am a new Mother Dirt product fan!  I've truly loved all the products I've tried from this line.  This moisturizer is no exception.  I've only been using the moisturizer for about a week, and I already love it.  It makes my skin feel great.

I love this stuff, all of it!  I don't know if I can attribute my softer younger looking skin all to this or somewhat to a better way of eating but I feel awesome.  I will continue to stay well stocked with Mother Dirt products.

The first thing I noticed is, most of my blackheads on my nose were gone!  But, have not seen many changes with rest of my face. I have more pimples and white heads, than I did as a teenager. Money is an issue for me. I want to use these products longer, just not sure I can afford them!

reviews.x: My skin has definitely changed for better.  Breakouts have stopped, blackheads nearly disappeared.  I use the cleanser as well.  Lots of people have complimented on how perfect my skin looks (not something I've heard before) my skin was always very combination and very sensitive. My only complaint is the packaging, it is leaky.

I use this product on my face morning and night after washing with Mother Dirt Cleanser. My skin feels great. My blemish and acne prone skin is clearer than it has been for years. I have been using the product for about six months and plan to continue.
I have used their products for over 2 years with great success. My skin feels like my own, healthy, and replenished.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the moisturizer absorbs quickly and leaves skin feeling soft and non-greasy.
Several reviewers report the product effectively clears dryness, flakiness, and breakouts.
A common complaint is the leaky or faulty bottle/nozzle that wastes product.
Some reviewers find it greasy, not moisturizing enough, or causing breakouts.
Some reviewers note surprise or dislike that it is an oil/liquid rather than a cream.
